gaps.sentence: Insure the camera ___ it gets damaged in transit.
gaps.explanation: 'In case it gets damaged' = as a precaution against damage.

gaps.sentence: ___ he had studied hard, he failed the exam.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' concedes a full clause; due/owing take noun phrases.

gaps.sentence: The economy has strengthened; ___, unemployment keeps rising.
gaps.explanation: Rising unemployment goes against the positive trend: however marks the contrast.

gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: No sooner had the applause died ___ the encore began.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner... than' is invariable; 'when' would be wrong here.

gaps.sentence: Demand for the vaccine soared; ___, production was doubled.
gaps.explanation: Soaring demand led to increased production: consequently marks the result.

gaps.sentence: The match was abandoned ___ the state of the pitch.
gaps.explanation: 'Owing to + noun' = because of, common in formal reporting.

gaps.sentence: ___ the weather improves, the crossing will be cancelled.
gaps.explanation: Unless = if the weather doesn't improve — matching the cancellation.
